scope: What the 2026-09-08 pan-and-right-light probe (25.2 s, 36 edges, status PROBE_CAPTURED_UNGRADED) established about panning the office view and the controls it moves. Run on story Night 3 at 12 AM inside a live night, terminal probe-complete, title cleanup verified.

controlPoints.note: Points the winning runners actuate that the checked-in profile apps/device/profiles/hid-mediaprojection.json does not carry, or carries differently. Recorded here so they are not lost with the gitignored run directory.

runLocalOnly.detail: absent from the profile controlMap entirely; exercised only by this probe

light.detail: the runner's flash point; the profile's 'light' is {350,615}, the same point as ventL, so the two names do not denote the same control. Flagged, not reconciled here.

observed: The office view pans horizontally under held contacts at panRight {2200,400} and panLeft {60,400}: the retained contact sheet shows the CELEBRATE poster, desk and monitor at different horizontal offsets across the probe.
The vent LIGHT buttons move with the view, appearing at different screen x in different pan states. A fixed vent-light coordinate is therefore only valid at a known pan position.

Six lifecycle observations across the probe all read state=night; the helper's own screen identity read FNAF2_MENU on two of them while lifecycle read night, consistent with the standing rule not to trust the helper for screen identity.

unknown.reason: tools/device/pan-shift.py refuses every pair of the six retained 2400x1080 screencaps: 'the two templates disagree ... the tracked content has probably left the strip' on five pairs and 'matched at the search bound ... saturated, not measured' on one. The 5 s capture cadence is far coarser than the 800 ms pan holds, and flashlight state changes between captures.
unknown.howToMeasureNext: capture 2400x1080 screencaps at sub-second cadence spanning a single pan hold with the flashlight state held constant, then run pan-shift.py on adjacent pairs. Do not rescale screenrecord frames to the native geometry to feed it: sensor.open_frame refuses a geometry the caller did not declare rather than resizing, and that refusal is the point.

modelNote: The right-vent hold this probe was calibrating is model-inert on Nights 3-4. tools/device/minus3-frame-light.mjs census(night, {knobs: {...WIN_KNOBS, secondHallVent}}) returns identical wins, minPower and minBox with the second contact as hall-only versus hall+rightVent at 3000 seeds each: Night 3 2993/3000 and Night 4 2977/3000 either way, minPower 3452 and 2452 either way.
